name: PostHog JS
solves: Provides feature flags, analytics, session replay, A/B testing, and product analytics as part of the PostHog platform, enabling teams to ship features behind flags while simultaneously capturing usage data and user behavior from JavaScript/TypeScript applications.
best_for: Teams wanting feature flags tightly integrated with product analytics and session replay in a single platform
Next.js or React apps needing autocapture analytics alongside feature flag evaluation
Organizations that want a self-hosted or cloud-hosted all-in-one product analytics and experimentation platform
Projects needing A/B testing with built-in statistical analysis tied to captured events
React Native mobile apps needing feature flags and analytics from a single SDK
skip_when: You need a lightweight, standalone feature flag solution without bundled analytics overhead
Your project requires a vendor-neutral feature flag setup using the OpenFeature standard
You are building a backend-only service that never needs browser analytics or session replay
You need a fully open-source self-hosted feature flag solution without any cloud dependency and PostHog's infrastructure requirements are too heavy
Your organization already has separate, established analytics and feature flag tools and does not want to consolidate
